records.title: AgentConductor: Topology Evolution for Multi-Agent Competition-Level Code Generation
records.read_coverage: Publisher metadata/abstract; arXiv sections2.1-2.3,4, AppendixC selected paragraphs; not full paper. No explicit hidden-test separation found by literal search, which does not establish its absence.
records.established: Learned layered-DAG orchestration evolves within one coding problem using execution feedback and density-aware rewards.
records.novelty_constraint: Execution-feedback-driven graph evolution is already covered; merely adding code execution cannot be a contribution.

records.title: LEMON: Learning Executable Multi-Agent Orchestration via Counterfactual Reinforcement Learning
records.venue: arXiv preprint; conference status not verified
records.read_coverage: Abstract; section3.4, AppendixC andD.7-D.8; not full paper.
records.established: Localized dependency/role/capacity edits supply contrastive RL updates; mutation-family sampling adapts from past absolute reward contrasts; exact node-context caching avoids unchanged computations.
records.novelty_constraint: Adaptive sampling of counterfactual edits and dependency-aware caching are not by themselves new. Inference-time maintenance with fixed workers requires a distinct question and equal-cost evidence.

records.title: CANTANTE: Optimizing Agentic Systems via Contrastive Credit Attribution
records.venue: arXiv preprint; conference status not verified
records.read_coverage: Abstract; section3.2 overview,4.4 selected discussion, AppendixB.3-B.4; not full paper.
records.established: Contrasts traces of multiple joint prompt configurations for per-agent optimizer updates. Its MBPP loop explicitly uses one visible test and holds two back for scoring.
records.novelty_constraint: Visible/hidden test separation and execution-supported agent credit optimization are established. Our small-model choice or different dataset alone is not a gap.
